subject: general
question: In each of the number-pairs, the second number is obtained by performing a certain mathematical operation on the first number. Three of the following pairs follow the same pattern and thus form a group. Select the number-pair that does NOT belong to that group.
solution:
The pattern followed here is **n² : (n + 1)**

 
• **Option1: **→ (18)² : (18 + 1) = 324:19
 
• **Option2: **→ (25)2 : (25 + 1) = 625:26
 
• Op
